description: Source file containing helper functions and classes for Vulkan renderer in ANGLE project, including validation layer checks, memory allocation, Vulkan result string mapping, and various Vulkan state conversions.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents Vulkan context, manages device and related operations.

classes.name: MemoryProperties
classes.description: Holds and manages Vulkan physical device memory properties.

classes.name: StagingBuffer
classes.description: Manages Vulkan staging buffer resources for data transfer.

classes.name: GarbageObject
classes.description: Represents Vulkan objects that need explicit destruction, manages cleanup.

methods.name: GetStagingBufferUsageFlags
methods.description: Returns Vulkan buffer usage flags based on staging usage type.

methods.name: ToEGL
methods.description: Converts Vulkan result to EGL error, using DisplayVk.

methods.name: HasValidationLayer
methods.description: Checks if a specific Vulkan validation layer is present.

methods.name: HasKhronosValidationLayer
methods.description: Checks for Khronos validation layer presence.

methods.name: HasStandardValidationLayer
methods.description: Checks for standard validation layer presence.

methods.name: HasValidationLayers
methods.description: Checks if all required validation layers are available.

methods.name: FindAndAllocateCompatibleMemory
methods.description: Finds suitable memory type and allocates Vulkan device memory.

methods.name: AllocateAndBindBufferOrImageMemory
methods.description: Allocates and binds memory for Vulkan buffers or images.

methods.name: AllocateBufferOrImageMemory
methods.description: Allocates memory for Vulkan buffer or image based on requirements.

methods.name: VulkanResultString
methods.description: Returns a string description for Vulkan VkResult codes.

methods.name: GetAvailableValidationLayers
methods.description: Determines which validation layers are available and enabled.

methods.name: GetDepthStencilAspectFlags
methods.description: Returns aspect flags for depth/stencil formats.

methods.name: GetFormatAspectFlags
methods.description: Returns aspect flags for a given format.

methods.name: MemoryProperties::init
methods.description: Initializes memory properties from physical device.

methods.name: StagingBuffer::init
methods.description: Initializes Vulkan staging buffer with specified size and usage.

methods.name: InitShaderAndSerial
methods.description: Creates Vulkan shader module and updates serial.

methods.name: Get2DTextureType
methods.description: Determines Vulkan texture type based on layer count and samples.

methods.name: GarbageObject::destroy
methods.description: Destroys Vulkan object based on handle type.
